lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately three horizontal rows aligned with the longitudinal axis. The most distinct clusters are located between the uppermost and medial carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular spots, creating a grid-like arrangement where vertical and horizontal patterns meet.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank; each ridge exhibits a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-density spot patterning is visible on the dorsal surface of the large, foreground pectoral fin, characterized by smaller, more closely packed circular maxima compared to the lateral flank.
